issues.issue: Split of the Taxes line is by fund column, not a printed tax-type breakdown; 'inheritance tax' is inferred from the fund name. Plausible for a Nebraska county Inheritance fund, but it is an assumption.

issues.on_page: Visitors Promotion Taxes 94,457; Visitor's Improvement Taxes 94,462; 911 Emergency Management Taxes 21,580

issues.on_page: Misc. - General Government 3,514,867 (under General Government heading)
issues.issue: Label and schedule heading say General Government; recorded as culture/recreation because p4 prints General Fund Culture and Recreation 3,514,867. Defensible, but label and category don't match.
Category rules list noxious weed control under natural resources/conservation; recorded as streets/highways to tie to p4 General Fund Public Works 65,941 (Surveyor 63,425 + Weed 2,517 = 65,942).

Self-insurance fund receipts are probably premium contributions or reimbursements, not truly miscellaneous; nothing printed describes them, so 'other' with review is allowed but uncertain. The same applies to receipts[6] (1,619,327).
